installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Paper Installation Script for Cinammon.net
PROJECT=paper

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
    echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g'))
else
    API_PROJECT=$(curl -s -H "User-Agent: curl/8.4.0" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}")

    if [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ]; then
        MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(echo "$API_PROJECT" | jq -r '.versions | to_entries | .[].value[]' | grep -v '-' | head -n1)
    fi

    echo -e "Minecraft Version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"

    API_BUILDS=$(curl -s -H "User-Agent: curl/8.4.0" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}")

    if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ]; then
        BUILD_NUMBER=$(echo "$API_BUILDS" | jq -r '.builds | max')
    fi

    echo -e "Paper Build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"

    API_BUILD_INFO=$(curl -s -H "User-Agent: curl/8.4.0" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}")
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo "$API_BUILD_INFO" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].url // empty')

    if [ -z "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ]; then
        JAR_NAME=$(echo "$API_BUILD_INFO" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].name // "'"${PROJECT}-${MINECRAFT_VERSION}-${BUILD_NUMBER}.jar"'"')
        DOWNLOAD_URL="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/downloads/${JAR_NAME}"
    fi
fi

cd /mnt/server

echo -e "Downloading Paper server from: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
fi

curl -sSL -H "User-Agent: curl/8.4.0" -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo -e "Creating default server.properties"
    cat << 'EOF' > server.properties
server-ip=0.0.0.0
server-port=25565
query.port=25565
motd=A Cinammon.net Minecraft Server
EOF
fi

if [ ! -d mods ]; then
    mkdir -p mods
fi
if [ ! -d plugins ]; then
    mkdir -p plugins
fi

echo -e "Paper installation complete!"
